title: Absolute Surrender
author: Andrew Murray
tradition_notes: Murray was a South African Dutch Reformed minister and prolific devotional writer. Influenced by the Keswick holiness movement, his works emphasize consecration, abiding in Christ, and dependence on the Holy Spirit.
source_edition: CCEL ThML edition (sourced via CCEL.org). Original: Marshall Brothers, London, 1895. A series of addresses on full consecration to God.
